entries.scope: Confidential vulnerability reporting and project-specific security policy for TinyPl0
entries.rationale: Owner-approved German-first and equivalent-English reporting policy; existing response targets retained. The unchanged exact-version package gate now reports actual public package dependency metadata when CI differs from local verification; no assertion is weakened.
readerPaths: GitHub Security -> Security policy -> private advisory -> coordinated disclosure
entries.navigationImpact: GitHub discovers this policy; reporting links target this repository.
entries.languageStrategy: Complete German first, equivalent English second; CEFR B2 and applicable WCAG 2.2 AA criteria.
entries.platformAndExampleProof: Bash and PowerShell documentation validation; exact reporting paragraphs, repository URLs, UTF-8, languages and headings. GitHub rendering checked at delivery; no new VoiceOver, NVDA or Braille acceptance claimed.
entries.risk: Reporting policy is no security certificate or new SLA. CodeQL configuration is separate and changes no AI Scan settings.
entries.reevaluationTrigger: Reporting route, project boundaries, supported branch, response process or GitHub rendering changes.

entries.scope: Deterministic exact-version TinyPl0.Vm to TinyPl0.Core NuGet package boundary
entries.risk: The pack hook uses NuGet project-reference metadata; retain the strict generated-nuspec and independent-consumer gate when SDK/NuGet changes.
entries.platformAndExampleProof: Unchanged independent consumer gate passes locally with SDK 10.0.404. Linux, Windows and macOS CI must pass at the final exact head. No package release is performed.
entries.languageStrategy: Complete German first, equivalent English second; CEFR B2 and applicable WCAG 2.2 AA criteria.
readerPaths: VM package README -> exact dependency contract -> independent package validation
entries.rationale: CI intermittently emitted a minimum version 0.4.1 instead of the existing exact [0.4.1] contract. Pin the final pack metadata without weakening the independent consumer gate or changing runtime APIs.
entries.navigationImpact: Existing package README gains the matching validation explanation.
entries.reevaluationTrigger: SDK, NuGet pack target, project-reference metadata or package version changes.
